prepare validates the checkpoint's own structure, not ECS referential integrity -- a missing referenced Uid is not yet a prepare-time reject
duplicate entity creation is not yet detected at prepare; it needs the ECS preflight CKPT-116 also names

commit currently runs inside handle_messages; its ordering against the client's own State::tick is not yet pinned by a test
the inverse of CKPT-123, same missing ordering pin
nothing re-checks entity generations between prepare and commit; the window exists because dispatch happens after commit
no post-commit state root is computed or carried yet (bootstrap_manifest_root is always None), so there is nothing to compare
